name: Rendering-Free Pruning via Hessian Importance
aliases: Super-Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting Pruning via Rendering-Free Primitive Importance
definition: A rendering-free, post-processing pruning framework for 3DGS that quantifies primitive importance using an analytically approximated Hessian field, bypassing costly forward rendering passes.
summary: REFINE is a post-processing framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that prunes primitives using an analytically approximated Hessian field, bypassing rasterization to achieve significant speedups.
